# Giving the Model Hands {#sec-giving-the-model-hands}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "agents are products you buy" — a tool is a function the model
may ask you to run.

Installs: tool descriptions as the real interface; what the model
sends back; why the caller, not the model, executes anything. Working
build: one function (a calculator or date lookup) the model learns to
request.
:::
